cohort: The study included 331 pregnant women and their newborns attending the public health network in Maceio, a Northeastern Brazilian capital.
finding: The prevalence of SGA newborns was 5.1%, and maternal employment outside the home was identified as a protective factor against SGA.
birth_weight: Birth weight below the 10th percentile according to INTERGROWTH-21st curves, adjusted for gestational age and gender, was classified as SGA.
gest_age: Gestational age was used to classify SGA infants, defined as those below the 10th percentile for gestational age and gender using INTERGROWTH-21st curves.
